facts.fact: Estiene 夜里在五年级宿舍后门外盯梢 Jehan；Jehan 没穿灰袍，按规矩就不该离开学院范围
facts.anchor: He wasn’t wearing his grey robe, which meant that by the rules

facts.fact: Jehan 的目的地是北码头区一座窗户用布遮黑的仓库；Estiene 付了明显被抬高的入场费后进入
facts.anchor: He was admitted after paying a door-fee

facts.fact: Jehan 臂上戴亮蓝色治疗师臂带，在擂台边当治疗师：给斗士做诊断、把脱臼的鼻子推回、把被撕掉的耳朵接回去
facts.anchor: One man’s ear was ripped clean off, and Jehan stepped in to reattach it

facts.fact: Jehan 脱到只剩腰间，臂上仍戴蓝带，用蓝绑带与「绿绑带」对手对打
facts.anchor: The blue band was still around his arm. It was the only thing he wore above the waist.

facts.fact: Jehan 的肩膀被指甲抓开、血流不止；他抬手查看后选择不治疗，留下伤口
facts.anchor: then lifted his bloodied hand away with the gouges unhealed

facts.fact: Jehan 把对手拖倒在地，手臂钩住对方脖子；绿绑带拍地认输
facts.anchor: Green tapped out. It was over.

facts.fact: Estiene 谎称 Jehan 在等他，金织锦外套的男人放行，另一名壮汉把他领进治疗师工作间（有床、绷带、补剂、缝合包），但 Jehan 不在
facts.anchor: This wasn’t just a dressing room. It was a healer’s workroom.

facts.fact: Jehan 回来撞见 Estiene，愣住说 What the fuck；Estiene 穿过房间，魔法从指尖涌出，搜寻 Jehan 的伤
facts.anchor: Magic flooded out from his fingertips
